root_cause.text: The `load_segments()` function in the kexec path invalidates the GS base (used by KCOV for per-CPU data), but KCOV instrumentation remains active afterward, causing any subsequent instrumented C code call (e.g., `native_gdt_invalidate()`) to crash when it attempts to access per-CPU data via the now-invalid GS base.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "The load_segments() function changes segment registers, invalidating GS base (which KCOV relies on for per-cpu data). When CONFIG_KCOV is enabled, any subsequent instrumented C code call (e.g. native_gdt_invalidate()) begins crashing the kernel in an endless loop." The patch disables KCOV instrumentation for `machine_kexec_64.c` and `physaddr.c` to prevent this scenario, confirming the root cause.
